title: Honest Scope: The Irreducible Factor, Not Its Exact Degree
content: This entry proves the STRUCTURAL half of the parent's OQ-02 refinement: that minpoly ℚ (cos 2π/n) is an irreducible factor of Tₙ − 1, for all n ≥ 1, with 0 axioms. It does NOT prove the sharp degree deg(minpoly) = φ(n)/2 — that is a field-degree statement requiring [ℚ(ζ_n):ℚ(cos 2π/n)] = 2 (complex conjugation fixing the maximal real subfield), which is not in Mathlib 4.26. The degree fact here is only the non-sharp bound deg(minpoly) ≤ deg(Tₙ − 1).
mathContext: Proved: $\operatorname{minpoly}_{\mathbb Q}(\cos 2\pi/n) \mid (T_n - 1)$ and irreducible. Open: $\deg = \varphi(n)/2$ (needs the maximal-real-subfield degree).

title: Base Change: Reusing the Parent's Real Identity over ℚ
content: The minimal polynomial lives in ℚ[X], but the parent proved Tₙ(cos 2π/n) = 1 over ℝ. aeval_cos_cheb bridges the two: aeval equals eval-after-map (aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map), and Polynomial.Chebyshev.map_T sends the rational Chebyshev polynomial to the real one under algebraMap ℚ ℝ. So the parent's real theorem is reused verbatim as the ℚ-algebra evaluation, with no new analysis.

title: Nonvanishing of Tₙ − 1 via One Off-Root Evaluation
content: Integrality and the degree bound both need Tₙ − 1 ≠ 0. Mathlib has no natDegree lemma for Chebyshev Tₙ, so chebT_sub_one_ne_zero instead evaluates at cos(π/n): if Tₙ − 1 = 0 then Tₙ = 1 as a polynomial, but Tₙ(cos(π/n)) = cos(n·π/n) = cos π = −1 ≠ 1 (T_real_cos + Real.cos_pi). One carefully chosen point that is NOT a root of Tₙ − 1 settles nonvanishing for every n ≥ 1.

title: minpoly.dvd and minpoly.irreducible: The Irreducible Factor
content: The two headline results. minpoly_cos_dvd_chebT applies minpoly.dvd to aeval(cos 2π/n)(Tₙ − 1) = 0, giving minpoly ℚ (cos 2π/n) ∣ (Tₙ − 1) — the minimal polynomial is a factor of Tₙ − 1. minpoly_cos_irreducible applies minpoly.irreducible to the integrality proof. Together they say precisely that the minimal polynomial is an irreducible factor of Tₙ − 1, the structural content of the parent's open question.
